description: For a disk requirement (category and/or min_iops), return the single cheapest disk from EACH cloud provider, ordered cheapest-first. Best for 'which cloud has the cheapest SSD sustaining 50k IOPS'.

category.description: disk tier: hdd, standard_ssd, balanced_ssd, perf_ssd, or ultra

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, CN, SG

disk_type.description: raw disk type substring, e.g. gp3, cloud_essd_pl1, ESSD

max_gib_month_usd.description: max price in USD per GiB per month

min_iops.description: only disk types whose max IOPS >= this (avoid DB/RDS bottleneck)

min_throughput_mbps.description: only disk types whose max throughput (MBps) >= this

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

name: compare_disk_providers
title: Cheapest disk per cloud
